safety_verdicts.content: Chest pain radiates to the shoulder and neck.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated documents radiation to left arm and shoulder but does not include radiation to the neck as stated in the gold fact.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting neck radiation can slightly weaken documentation of classic acute coronary syndrome (ACS) features and may affect downstream risk stratification or handover clarity. However, other high-risk features (central pressure, left arm/shoulder radiation) are still present, so the core concern is unlikely to be missed.
